idea-plugin.name: GitLab CI Break Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Names the .gitlab-ci.yml lines your runner will reject after the next GitLab major upgrade

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → GitLab CI Break Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 16 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/gitlab-ci-break-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/gitlab-ci-break-lint

action.text: GitLab CI Break Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run GitLab CI Break Lint on the file in the editor
